ItemId.description: The schedule's 26-character id; omit it to match by name or create one.

AnchorDate.description: A day a period starts on (yyyy-MM-dd), for weekly, every-two-weeks and every-four-weeks schedules; its month starts quarterly and yearly ones.

WeekStart.description: The day the overtime week starts.

SecondPeriodStartDay.description: The day the second period of a twice-a-month schedule starts on, 2 to 28.

PayDateRule.description: How the pay date is found.

PayDateOffsetDays.description: Days after the period ends that pay is made.

FirstPayDay.description: Day of the month the first period is paid, for fixed days; 0 is the last day.

SecondPayDay.description: Day of the month the second period is paid, for fixed days; 0 is the last day.

NonBusinessDayShift.description: Where a pay date on a day off moves.

ApprovalLeadDays.description: Days before the pay date a run must be approved.

ExtraPayPeriod.description: How a salary is paid in a year with one more pay date than usual.

Enabled.description: Whether the schedule is in use.

Schedules.description: The pay schedules to create, or update by id or name.
